seo.title: Maple Inc Website UI Design | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: A seven-screen corporate product catalogue website UI concept for home-textile manufacturer Maple Inc.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This concept treats the website as a small system rather than a single promotional page. It brings together brand introduction, manufacturing credibility, product categories and contact information across seven desktop screens.

sections.heading: Scope note
sections.body: This project is presented as a multi-page visual UI concept. It demonstrates page consistency and catalogue structure, without claiming formal user research or usability testing.
